displayDescription: Constructivist study: a halftone bulb cutout rides a -12° diagonal into a hub, a red band slashes in, spokes connect four nodes.
audioDescription: Silent preview. No audio track was produced.
limitations: The 'photographic cutout' is a procedural halftone light bulb (deterministic Lambert/specular dot shading in SVG), not a real photograph.
Print grain is a static seeded SVG feTurbulence approximation of newsprint/film grain, not a scanned texture.
The Motion library was reviewed but not used. GSAP alone owns every animated property, so each property has one owner.

Typography uses OS-bundled Impact and Arial Black, declared through @font-face src: local(). No font files are embedded, so a render host without these fonts falls back to system sans, which changes glyph widths.

The palette is a scene-dependent choice: an ink-navy ground with off-white ink and a single construction red. It follows the reference's role structure, not its colors; the STYLE.json cream swatch was treated as an example only.
STYLE.json lists no tech.preview_recipes, so this refresh demonstrates tech.implementation: cutout + diagonal SVG masks + real text on one directional axis.
